blurb: Guests can do tandem skydives from 10,000 ft with certified instructors or progress through a Gradual Freefall Program toward solo licensing. Licensed skydivers can do fun jumps from 10,000 ft or 4,000 ft. The student program includes ground school and progressive jumps with instructor assistance.
extraNote: Video packages optional add-on starting at $120 · Time to solo license varies; usually 15-25 jumps after first jump course · Salmon Arm Municipal Airport
